About the role

ABOUT US At the heart of AG1 lies a commitment to our mission to empower people to take ownership of their health. Since 2010, we've dedicated ourselves to bringing Foundational Nutrition to people around the world.&nbsp; Our ethos is deeply rooted in science, with an unwavering dedication to continuous improvement. We leverage and contribute to the latest research to deliver a powerful, straightforward solution for optimal health to our customers. We harness the finest ingredients so that every scoop of AG1 gives you the nutrients you need with the simplicity you want in a daily routine. Likewise, our organization puts the same energy into creating an environment that is a reflection of the cultural values that define who we are and how we work together. THE ROLE AG1 is seeking a Manager, Retail Finance to support our business as we expand our presence in grocery, mass, club, and other retailers. This high-impact role is responsible for partnering with our Retail Team and across the organization to deliver the retail strategy and budgeted financial targets, work to improve product COGS, develop trade spend visibility and efficiencies, ensure accuracy of Retailer fines/fees/deductions, assist in the order to cash process, and other duties as assigned. Reporting to the Director, Retail Finance the successful candidate is an experienced finance business partner to Commercial/Retail Sales with a strong understanding of the grocery, mass, club, and natural retail landscape.&nbsp; This role requires a mix of strong partnership skills, analytical and financial acumen, and the ability to both execute existing and build new processes. &nbsp; WHAT YOU’LL DO Visibility and Tracking Support the execution of the strategic sales plan and budget to expand the AG1 footprint within retail partners across the US. Create dashboarding which brings together external and internal data to enable KPI financial tracking and enhances performance visibility Financial analysis on new business opportunities, assess competitive dynamics, and proactively address challenges to drive growth.
